response.rationale: The item is electronics delivered 20 days ago. The electronics-specific rule RET-003 (priority 20) applies since days_since_delivery > 15, making the return ineligible. This higher-priority electronics rule dominates the standard 30-day window rule RET-007 (priority 10). No higher-priority rules apply: final_sale, defective, goodwill_grant, and fraud_hold are all false.
